LU1681038672.method: Complete issuer-published economic index exposure, not fund assets or substitute basket. Original rounded index weights; the publisher may delay the observation under index-provider licensing restrictions. Fund cash, fees, swaps and currency hedges excluded. Equity-member weights use the same closing float-adjusted market values across the standard Russell2000 price/gross/net return series. Withholding tax changes the dividend return calculation, not these market values. Only equity weights are referenced; RU20INTR returns never replace RU20N30U returns. Hedged, capped, style and leveraged variants are excluded.
